title: Protesters Demand End to Load-Shedding and Sewage Spills Across South Africa
detail: South African protesters took to the streets demanding an end to ongoing power cuts (load-shedding) and sewage spills affecting communities. The demonstrations reflect widespread public frustration over persistent infrastructure failures that have plagued the country, with residents calling on the government to address the electricity crisis and deteriorating sanitation infrastructure.

media.caption: South African protesters demand an end to load-shedding and sewage spills
